judged_text: The posts loop renders `post.user.small_avatar_url` and `post.user.username` per post, but the controller constructs TopicView.new(topic_id, current_user, {best: 5}) with no explicit eager loading of users. Each of the up-to-5 best posts triggers a separate user lookup (and post.url lookups) per embed render; on a page embedded across many articles this multiplies into thousands of extra queries per hour for content that never changes between the 1-minute cache expiries.
